hero.title: Not Just Cashews | Traceable Cashews from Ivory Coast.
hero.subtitle: We built our own farm operating system to track every tree, every block, and every export. Direct from our 35-hectare farm in Odienné, Côte d'Ivoire.

aboutPreview.title: A Tech-Enabled Farm, Rooted in Three Generations
aboutPreview.description: Most West African farms run on paper. Ours runs on a custom-built operating system — engineered by our founder to bring institutional-grade transparency to cashew production. From our 35-hectare farm in Odienné, we're proving that African agribusiness can lead with technology.

traceability.title: Traceable from Tree to Container
traceability.description: Our custom Farm OS tracks every cashew from the block it was harvested to the container it ships in. Buyers and investors get real-time visibility into origin, quality, and handling — not just a paper trail.

farm.title: 35 Hectares. 3,500 Trees. One Operating System.
farm.description: Located in the heart of Ivory Coast's cashew belt, our family farm is managed through Farm OS — a custom platform that tracks every tree, every expense, and every harvest. We combine three generations of farming knowledge with modern technology to produce premium cashews with complete traceability.

sustainability.title: Organic. Ethical. Tech-Enabled.
sustainability.description: At AfriNuts Export, sustainability is measurable — not just a promise. Our Farm OS tracks our environmental impact alongside our production data. Organic farming practices, fair wages, and zero-waste processing are documented, not just claimed.

features.title: Organic Farming

farmOsTeaser.title: Powered by Farm OS — Our Custom Operating System
farmOsTeaser.description: Most farms run on paper. Ours runs on software we built — an offline-first Android app with cloud sync, real-time dashboards, and block-level tracking. The same system our farm managers use. The same data our investors see.

investorLetter.title: From Investor to CTO — In His Own Words
investorLetter.subtitle: When Alassana Bah first saw the AfriNuts pitch deck, he was skeptical. Then he flew to Odienné, walked the farm, and reviewed the code. He didn't just invest — he joined full-time.
investorLetter.emailPreviewAlt: Alassana Bah's investor email to Hamza Sangare
investorLetter.pullQuote: Most agribusinesses I've looked at are hoping their tech vendor will eventually solve traceability. AfriNuts already solved it. I invested because the farmland is real. I joined full-time because the software is what makes it valuable.
investorLetter.attribution: — Alassana Bah, Chief Technology Officer & Early Investor
